units.source_text: 你还是个童男子，可一点也不是个美丽的重男子。

en.t: You are still a virgin, but you are not in the least a beautiful young man.

units.source_text: 你不受女人的欢迎，也没有嫖女人的勇气。

en.t: Women do not like you, and you do not have the courage to buy a woman either.
That is all there is to it.

units.source_text: 但是，倘使你为了要在童贞者中间找个朋友而同我交往，那就特错大错了。

en.t: But if you are associating with me because you want to find a friend among virgins, then you are making a very grave mistake.

units.source_text: 我为什么抛弃童贞，让我来告诉你吧。"

en.t: Let me tell you why I abandoned my virginity.
